subject.name: ELEMENTARY DESIGN OF RCC AND STEEL SECTIONS
subject.source: Syllabus/Diploma_Full_Collection_1/Marwadi_Official_Diploma_Collector/Marwadi_Diploma_Syllabus_Collection/Verified_Syllabi/Diploma Civil Engineering/Semester_Unspecified/09CI0510 - Theory Component ELEMENTARY DESIGN OF RCC AND STEEL SECTIONS.pdf

content: Introduction to Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) , Advantages
and limitation of RCC, Necessity of steel as a reinforcing material
Various grades of concrete and steel, , Introduction to IS codes & IS
code requirements for design and detailing

chapters.chapter_name: ELEMENTARY DESIGN OF RCC AND STEEL SECTIONS 09CI0510
content: Assumptions for Limit State of Collapse due to Flexure, , Concept
of Balance Section, Under Reinforced Section, Over Reinforced
Section. , General features of singly reinforced & doubly reinforced
beams,, Necessity of providing doubly reinforcements, Design
problems of singly-reinforced rectangular beam
Definition and classification of slabs as one-way and two-way slabs
support conditions, main and distribution steel., Specifications
regarding spacing and cover for reinforcement, effective, span
minimum reinforcement, Design procedure on design of simply
supported one way slab. , Design procedure on design of simply
supported two way slab with corners free to lift

chapters.chapter_name: Design of RCC column and footing
content: Definition and classification of column, Limit state of compression
members, Effective length of column., Provisions of IS 456 for
minimum steel, cover, maximum steel, spacing of ties etc., Design
of axially loaded short column(Square, Rectangular), Design
procedure of isolated footings(pad footing only)

chapters.chapter_name: Design of bolted and welded connection
content: Simple numerical on design strength of bolt in shear, tension and
bearing , Introduction and types of welds (butt and fillet
Advantages and disadvantages of welded connections, size of weld
throat thickness, , Procedure for analysis and design of welded joint
(only fillet weld) for members subjected to axial load
